# World History Encyclopedia

> A comprehensive, free online encyclopedia providing fact-checked articles, interactive timelines, historical maps, and educational resources covering world civilizations from ancient times to the present.

World History Encyclopedia is a non-profit organization dedicated to making history accessible through a vast collection of peer-reviewed content, multimedia resources, and teaching materials. The site serves both general learners and educators with membership options, institutional subscriptions, and exclusive features like monthly historian lectures and curated collections.

## Key Topics

- Ancient Civilizations
- Medieval History
- World History
- Roman Empire
- Ancient Egypt
- Europe

## Core Content & Discovery

- [World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org): Free online history encyclopedia with fact-checked articles, images, videos, maps, timelines
- [Index - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/index): Alphabetical index of World History Encyclopedia articles and content
- [Timeline - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/timeline): Interactive timeline search tool with 14419 world history events and filters
- [World History Maps - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/mapselect): Atlas of interactive and static historical maps covering world civilizations
- [Collections (p. 1) - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/edu/collections): Galleries of curated image collections and historical maps organized by topic

## Education & Teaching Resources

- [Free Education Resources - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/edu): Overview of free teaching materials and educational resources for history educators
- [Teaching Materials - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/edu/teaching-resources): Lesson plans with supplementary materials, handouts, assessments, and downloadable content
- [Quizzes (p. 1) - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/type/11/1): Collection of educational quizzes on ancient history and world civilizations
- [History Lectures - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/static/members-lectures): Monthly lecture series by guest historians available to members and institutions
- [Contribute - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/contribute): Guidelines for submitting articles, multimedia content, and user-generated contributions

## Membership & Subscriptions

- [Membership - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/membership): Membership subscription page supporting non-profit organization's history education mission
- [Institutional Subscriptions - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/edu/subscription): Institutional subscription plans for schools and universities with ad-free access
- [World History Insider - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/shop/magazines/insider): Exclusive members-only magazine with editorials, features, interviews, exhibitions

## Reference & Curation

- [Link Database - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/xres): Curated database of external educational links and museum resources recommended by editors
- [Translations - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/trans): Overview of multilingual translations of World History Encyclopedia content

## Optional

- [History Book Reviews - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/books): In-depth reviews of history books by World History Encyclopedia reviewers
- [Needed Content - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/static/needed): List of priority history topics and cultures seeking contributor submissions
